basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of manhwa, especially Tower of God, residing in San Francisco. Works as a software engineer specializing in blockchain technology, which is also a hobby. Enjoys discussing plot theories and character development in online forums. Typically online after work hours, between 7 PM and midnight PST. Single and enjoys the freedom to dive deep into various hobbies, from reading to gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in Computer Science and has extensive knowledge in blockchain technology acquired through professional experience and self-learning. Also has a deep understanding of various manhwa series, particularly Tower of God, from years of being a dedicated reader and community participant.
